parameters.content:
## $0 by design — same copy/paste pattern as Phase 1-2

No Anthropic API key here either. This pauses on a form showing you the QC
Agent's exact system prompt (Agent #7 in 03-AGENT-PROMPTS.md) — copy it into
your own Claude.ai / Claude Code chat, then paste the JSON verdict back.

## Honest limitation: VISUAL / AUDIO / EDITING

This workflow gives Claude the script, dossier claims, asset license notes,
and the render URL/duration as TEXT — it cannot make Claude actually watch
or listen to the rendered MP4 by itself. Before pasting the prompt into
your Claude chat, open `render_url` yourself (or in a Claude session that
can browse) and actually watch/listen to it — otherwise those 3 categories
are a guess, not a real QC pass, and this is the last gate before publish.

## Hard rules this workflow enforces itself (not just trusting the paste)

- Any asset on this video missing `license_note` forces COPYRIGHT (and
  therefore overall) to FAIL, regardless of what the pasted JSON says —
  matches 05-PRODUCTION-HARDENING.md #8: "a missing provenance record is a
  hard publish blocker."
- `overall_pass` requires ALL 5 categories to pass, recomputed here rather
  than trusted from the paste.

## Before running this

1. Requires a video at `videos.stage = 'rendered'` (Phase 4, or Phase 4B's
   Render Poll, must have completed first).
2. Reuses the **Supabase account** credential — wire it into every HTTP
   node that hits `/rest/v1/...`.
3. Activate, open the Form Trigger's Production URL, enter the exact Topic
   Title.
4. On a pass: `videos.stage = 'qc_passed'`. On a fail: nothing changes on
   the video except a new `qc_reports` row — go fix the stage named in
   `rework_reason`/`rework_stage` by hand (re-run that phase's form), then
   re-submit this form. On the 3rd fail for the same video:
   `videos.status = 'needs_human'` — no auto-loop, no email alert wired
   yet (no Resend/Gmail credential exists in this n8n instance); the
   read-only dashboard is where that shows up for now.
